card.title: Keeper of the Peace
card.instruction: Project calm authority over the relationship while carefully avoiding anything that might expose how fragile the peace really is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made soup. We can have a perfectly calm dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need to discuss why I slept in the spare room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After soup. I'll handle dinner; we don't need to disturb anything tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hand is shaking. Let me carry that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You pour. I'll hold the tray with both hands. We can still carry dinner in together.
